from flask import Flask
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config["SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

class Todo(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)

def test_bug():
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()
        for _ in range(150):
            db.session.add(Todo())
        db.session.commit()

        p = Todo.query.paginate(per_page=110, max_per_page=200)
        assert len(p.items) == 110

        p2 = p.next()
        assert len(p2.items) == 40
